author: (Linnaeus, 1758)
evidence: Robinson & Montoya 1987 (Rev. Biol. Trop. 35): collected on the Caribbean coast of Costa Rica, at Cahuita, Manzanillo and in dredged material at Moín (as Trachycardium muricatum)
iNaturalist: 1 research-grade record in the region

about.en: The yellow cockle is a strong, round cockle with a yellowish shell, red-brown blotches and ribs, with short spines on the rear. It lives in sand and seagrass in shallow water, and the empty shells are easy to find on beaches along the coast. It was collected at Cahuita, Manzanillo and Moín in 1987 under the name Trachycardium muricatum. Cockles of this kind are a fine find for a shell walk; no local use as food was found.
about.es: El berberecho amarillo es un berberecho fuerte y redondo con concha amarillenta, manchas rojizas y costillas, con espinas cortas en la parte trasera. Vive en arena y pasto marino en aguas someras y las conchas vacías son fáciles de encontrar en las playas de la costa. Se colectó en Cahuita, Manzanillo y Moín en 1987 con el nombre Trachycardium muricatum. Los berberechos de este tipo son un buen hallazgo para una caminata de conchas; no se encontró uso local como alimento.

idTips.en: Round, inflated shell with about 30 ribs, rough spines at the rear, creamy yellow with reddish blotches, orange-yellow inside.
idTips.es: Concha redonda e inflada con unas 30 costillas, espinas ásperas atrás, amarillo cremoso con manchas rojizas y amarillo anaranjado por dentro.

diet.en: Filter feeder: it strains plankton and fine particles from the water through its short siphons.
diet.es: Filtrador: cuela plancton y partículas finas del agua con sus sifones cortos.

predators.en: Snails that drill shells, crabs, rays, bottom-feeding fish and shorebirds.
predators.es: Caracoles que perforan conchas, cangrejos, rayas, peces de fondo y aves playeras.

behaviour.en: Lives buried just under the sand, and can leap with its foot to escape a predator.
behaviour.es: Vive enterrado justo bajo la arena y puede saltar con el pie para escapar de un depredador.

reproduction.en: Spawns by releasing eggs and sperm into the water; the larvae drift as plankton.
reproduction.es: Desova soltando huevos y espermatozoides al agua; las larvas derivan como plancton.

where.en: Sand and seagrass at Cahuita and Manzanillo; shells on beaches along the coast.
where.es: Arena y pasto marino en Cahuita y Manzanillo; conchas en playas de toda la costa.

edibleNote.en: No local or regional use as food was found for this species.
edibleNote.es: No se encontró uso alimentario local ni regional de esta especie.

sources.t: Robinson & Montoya 1987, Los moluscos marinos de la Costa Atlántica de Costa Rica, Rev. Biol. Trop. 35(2): 375-400
